target_customer: Consumer-facing enterprises, especially CPG and quick-service restaurant brands, that make pricing, product and promotion decisions
problem: Brands commit to prices, launches and campaigns without a reliable way to predict consumer response; surveys and focus groups are slow and unreliable.
business_model: Enterprise software and services sold per engagement or subscription (pricing not stated)
product_category: Consumer behavior simulation and market research analytics

founders.name: Nikita Mullangi
education: UC Berkeley computer science (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page says she researched human behavior and decision making at MIT.

founders.name: Cameron Malloy
education: UC Berkeley M.E.T. program, EECS and Business Administration (per YC page)

competitors.name: Aaru
competitors.what: Synthetic populations of AI agents for market research and election prediction
competitors.traction_then: Series A at a $1B headline valuation

competitors.name: Vectorial
competitors.what: Human behavior simulation for product research

technical_complexity.rationale: Calibrating cohort-level simulations to real KPIs needs behavioral modeling and client data integration; the 95 to 97 percent accuracy claims are company-reported and unaudited.

defensibility.rationale: Well-funded rivals already sell synthetic panels, and the method is replicable by funded teams. Client data integration may add switching costs over time.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Simile raised a $200M Series B at a $2B valuation in July 2026, showing heavy competitor funding at the time of the batch.

market_need_then: Traditional survey response rates have fallen and brands pay for market research; synthetic respondent startups drew large rounds in 2025 and 2026. The company says it has 5 enterprise clients, company-reported.

branding.domain_note: Uses trystudio.ai rather than studio.com or studio.ai.

identity.visual_style: Minimal layout, gray and orange palette, '//' separators, illustrated scenes

branding.brand_signature: Orange used to mark the chosen path in simulations

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found; the name Studio is generic and shared by many unrelated products in search.

outcome_analysis: The company is active in the Summer 2026 batch with no exit and no verified funding. It sells into a hot synthetic research category where rivals have raised far more, so its outcome depends on whether its accuracy claims hold with enterprise clients.
notes: A $125k seed on Dealroom is a single aggregator figure with AI-generated summary, unverified and not recorded as a round. Accuracy claim differs between pages (95 vs 97 percent). Vectorial date is approximate. Outcome check: no acquisition, shutdown or layoff news found.
